text.offer: Rook says, "Every skill and spell you know gets better the more you use it. But you can push one along faster, with training points. You earn them from quests and from hard living. Open your Stats and press Train beside your training points, or just type 'train'. Pick something you know and spend a few points on it. Go on, I'm watching."
text.progress: Rook says, "Open your Stats and press Train beside your training points, or type 'train'. Choose a skill or spell, say how many percent, and spend the points."
text.complete: Rook says, "Good. Points don't do you any good sitting in your pocket. Spend them on what keeps you alive, and keep using it in the field."

steps.objective: Spend training points on a skill or spell
steps.brief: Training points raise a skill or spell you already know. Open the Train window (the Train button beside Training points in your Stats, or type 'train'), choose what to improve and by how many percent, and spend them. Each skill or spell costs a different number of points per percent.
